Reconstructed all 27 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The poem’s grammar supports Punjabi, so I updated the language metadata and removed the missing-source tag.

The Roman readings “Re,” “Ayontaan,” and “Bajiyaan” are ambiguous. I rendered them as رہے, اونٹاں, and بجھیاں.
